items.title: Pay invoice for leaf removal and gutter cleaning
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: The invoice sets a payment period of 10 days starting from receipt ("Erhalt") of the invoice, not from its issue date. Under section 187(1) BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted; the period would run for the following 10 calendar days, and under section 188(1) BGB it would end with the expiry of the 10th day (shifted to the next business day under section 193 BGB if it fell on a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday). However, the letter carries no printed invoice/issue date and does not otherwise state when it was sent or received, so the start of the period cannot be established from the document itself. Without a known receipt date, the exact calendar due date cannot be computed.

warnings: The invoice itself carries no printed date, so the 10-day payment period ("innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung") cannot be anchored to a concrete start date; the user should check the envelope or email date on which they actually received this invoice to compute the exact due date themselves.
The amounts 160.00, 110.00 and 51.30 EUR are individual line items (service charges and VAT) and were excluded from amounts; only the total of 321.30 EUR is the sum actually payable.
